description: Delete one or more records from a table in a single batch call. The returned deleted count equals rowIds.length (optimistic) — already-deleted rows are silently skipped by the server.

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

tableId.description: The table ID containing the records

viewId.description: Optional view ID passed as UI context; does NOT filter which records are deleted — rowIds is the sole selector.

name: delete_records
